description: Land Acquisition - Atabage, Pallegama Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District, Weragoda, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District (Section 05)
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land parcels and servitude rights for public purposes (construction of access roads and water storage tanks), including precise descriptions of land lots, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister, the core content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or structural adjustments, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
